description: This file defines the RenderCache class in Drupal, implementing caching logic for render elements, including methods for retrieving, setting, and validating cache data, as well as handling cache tags and cacheability checks.

classes.name: RenderCache
classes.description: Implements caching logic for render elements in Drupal, managing cache retrieval, storage, and validation based on cache tags, cacheability, and HTTP methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RenderCache object with dependencies: RequestStack, VariationCacheFactoryInterface, and CacheContextsManager.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a single render element if cacheable and valid for the current HTTP method.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cached render elements efficiently, respecting cacheability and HTTP method constraints.

methods.name: isCacheableForCurrentHttpMethod
methods.description: Checks if cache tags are valid for the current HTTP request method.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a render element in cache if cacheable and the HTTP method allows caching.

methods.name: getCacheableRenderArray
methods.description: Prepares a render array for caching, including cache contexts, tags, max-age, and cacheable children.

methods.name: isElementCacheable
methods.description: Determines if a renderable array can be cached based on max-age and cache keys.
